summary: Iteration 3: Full backend + frontend testing of the NEW Site Image Manager (hero + gallery via Emergent object storage) plus regression on quote/leads flow. All 23 backend tests pass (12 new site-image tests + 11 pre-existing). Landing page renders dynamic hero-image and 4 gallery-item-* tiles sourced from /api/site-images. Admin login gated, tabs (Quote Leads, Site Images) both work. Gallery upload via UI (multipart FormData + X-Admin-Password header) returned 200 and tile appeared; delete button soft-deleted it and count returned to baseline. Hero replace test verified new hero replaces prior via API (original hero restored via direct DB update). DB left clean: 1 hero (Our Fleet) + 4 gallery items, no leftover TEST_ images.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~300 lines and mixes storage helpers, models, routes, and Twilio SMS. Consider extracting object-storage helpers into /app/backend/storage.py and site-images routes into /app/backend/routes/site_images.py before adding more features.

Storage init uses a module-level `_storage_key` cache and never handles rotation/expiry. If Emergent returns 401 later, subsequent uploads will silently keep the stale key. Consider re-initializing on 401/403 from put_object.
put_object / get_object are synchronous `requests` calls inside async endpoints and block the event loop. For upload throughput consider aiohttp or `await run_in_threadpool(...)`.

Upload endpoint reads full file into memory before size-check; a malicious 100MB upload would still be fully buffered before the 10MB check. Consider streaming or checking `file.size`/Content-Length up front.

DELETE /api/site-images/{id} soft-deletes but doesn't remove the underlying object from Emergent storage — orphaned blobs will accumulate over time. Add a cleanup job or hard-delete via the storage API.
resolveImageUrl only checks `url.startsWith('http')` — a protocol-relative URL (`//example.com/x.png`) would be wrongly prefixed with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Minor edge case only.
test_credentials: Admin password: tidyups2026 (verified). No other credentials required — object storage uses backend EMERGENT_LLM_KEY server-side.
seed_data_creation: Test run created 1 TEST_ImgIter Regression lead in the quotes collection (no delete endpoint exists for leads — same as prior iterations). All test-uploaded site images (1 gallery + 1 hero) were deleted; original hero was restored via pymongo un-soft-delete. Final DB state: 1 hero + 4 gallery (matches seed).
